stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, China Primary Energy Holdings Limited's core business involves the transmission and distribution of natural gas throughout the People's Republic of China. Its operations are structured across three key segments: natural gas transmission and distribution, the sale of heat and products derived from biomass gasification, and property investment. Furthermore, the company is involved in advancing and utilizing energy technologies, managing a heat and power cogeneration facility, and generating heat. Established in 2001, this entity was previously known as China Primary Resources Holdings Limited and maintains its headquarters in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong.
